sentences.zh: 山姆，你想先来吗？

sentences.en: I chose to answer this the same way Cody and Colin and Ainsley did,

sentences.en: as if we haven't seen each other every day for the last couple of years.

sentences.en: Oh, great.

sentences.en: So, John and Angela, it's so good to hear from you.

sentences.en: Second, life is good.

sentences.en: Life is small for me right now.
sentences.zh: 对现在的我来说，生活很简单。

sentences.en: I make two to three podcasts a week,
sentences.zh: 我一周制作两到三个播客，

sentences.en: which seems wild to me that I used to make five to ten per week for ten years.
sentences.zh: 这对我来说觉得很疯狂，我以前连续十年每周要做五到十个。

sentences.en: So, since I've seen you last, Earwolf was acquired by SiriusXM,
sentences.zh: 所以，自从上次见到你们以来，Earwolf 被 SiriusXM 收购了，

sentences.en: which was great for the owners of Earwolf.
sentences.zh: 这对 Earwolf 的老板们来说很棒。

sentences.en: Pretty weak for everyone else.
sentences.zh: 对其他所有人来说就挺弱的。

sentences.en: I made it about two years before being laid off,
sentences.zh: 我坚持了大约两年就被解雇了，

sentences.en: which I'll admit was terrifying.
sentences.zh: 我承认这真的很吓人。

sentences.en: But I don't know if you two remember the show I was on before I left,
sentences.zh: 但我不知道你们两个是否还记得我离开前做的那档节目，

sentences.en: The Office Ladies.
sentences.zh: 《办公室女士》。

sentences.en: Those two absolute angels swooped in and saved me
sentences.zh: 那两个绝对的天使从天而降拯救了我，

sentences.en: by rehiring me on the show I was laid off from,
sentences.zh: 通过在把我解雇的节目上重新雇用了我，

sentences.en: which, as far as I know,
sentences.zh: 据我所知，

sentences.en: that's the only instance of that happening that I can think of.
sentences.zh: 据我所能想到的，这是唯一发生过这种事的情况。

sentences.en: I got out of that toxic relationship I was in when we met.
sentences.zh: 我走出了我们相识时身处的那段有毒的关系。

sentences.en: I've recently started dating a lovely woman in Canada named Stephanie.
sentences.zh: 我最近开始和加拿大一位名叫斯蒂芬妮的可爱女士约会。

sentences.en: It's new to me.
sentences.zh: 这对我来说很新奇。

sentences.en: I'm taking it slowly, but I do love her very much.
sentences.zh: 我正在慢慢来，但我确实非常爱她。

sentences.en: My dog, Ramen, is still alive.
sentences.zh: 我的狗狗拉面还活着。

sentences.en: He turns nine this month.
sentences.zh: 它这个月九岁了。

sentences.en: He's still very fat and very dumb and very wonderful.
sentences.zh: 它依然很胖、很笨，而且非常可爱。

sentences.en: I got sober about a year ago.
sentences.zh: 我大约在一年前戒酒了。

sentences.en: I've been slowly rebuilding my life since then.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，我一直在慢慢重建我的生活。

sentences.en: No complaints, though.
sentences.zh: 不过没什么可抱怨的。

sentences.en: Whatever I left behind in my old life has been repaid to me currently ten times over.
sentences.zh: 我在旧生活中抛下的所有东西，现在都已经十倍地回报给我了。

sentences.en: As I wrap this up,
sentences.zh: 在我做个总结的时候，

sentences.en: I just wanted to say how good it is to hear from you both.
sentences.zh: 我只想说，听到你们两个的消息真是太好了。

sentences.en: You both changed my life in many ways,
sentences.zh: 你们两个在很多方面改变了我的生活，

sentences.en: and I'm proud to be a part of this show still.
sentences.zh: 而且我很自豪能一直成为这个节目的一部分。

sentences.en: I was aware from our very first taping that we had something special.
sentences.zh: 从我们第一次录制开始，我就意识到我们拥有特别的东西。

sentences.en: I lost all my emails from the last ten years when I left SiriusXM,
sentences.zh: 我离开SiriusXM时，弄丢了过去十年的所有电子邮件，

sentences.en: but I'm genuinely pretty sure you both have emails from me around that time
sentences.zh: 但我真心觉得你们俩当时大概都收到过我的邮件，

sentences.en: telling you guys in that very fact that you guys were on to something very magical here.
sentences.zh: 在那里面我就直说你们俩在这里搞出了某种非常神奇的名堂。

sentences.en: I tried to do the math, and by my rough estimate,
sentences.zh: 我试着算了一下，根据我粗略的估计，

sentences.en: I've made probably three to four thousand podcasts over the last decade.
sentences.zh: 在过去的十年里，我大概制作了三到四千期播客。

sentences.en: I've made some really magical stuff.
sentences.zh: 我制作了一些真正神奇的作品。

sentences.en: I've met some really truly special people,
sentences.zh: 我遇到了一些真正特别的人，

sentences.en: but it all pales in comparison to what you two have built here.
sentences.zh: 但与你们两个在这里建造的一切相比，这些都显得逊色。

sentences.en: You two have built a community.
sentences.zh: 你们两个建立了一个社区。

sentences.en: Every person that has talked to you today has used that phrase,
sentences.zh: 今天跟你们交谈过的每个人都用过这个词，

sentences.en: and podcasts end, but communities last forever.
sentences.zh: 播客会结束，但社区永存。

sentences.en: And to the people that email me saying they listen to the show
sentences.zh: 对于那些给我发邮件说他们听这个节目的人，

sentences.en: while they're running marathons, having babies, getting married,
sentences.zh: 在他们跑马拉松、生孩子、结婚的时候，

sentences.en: I see you, and I hear you, and every email blows my mind.
sentences.zh: 我看见了你们，我也听到了你们，每一封邮件都让我震撼。

sentences.en: Thank you, truly.
sentences.zh: 真的，谢谢你们。

sentences.en: I'm always available.
sentences.zh: 我随时都有空。

sentences.en: Please email me at the next 500 million mark.
sentences.zh: 等下一个五亿大关时请给我发邮件。

sentences.zh: 噢，萨姆。

sentences.zh: 对，对。

sentences.en: You wrote it as if Jenna and I were sitting in the room with you.
sentences.zh: 你写的时候，就好像我和珍娜正和你呆在同一个房间里一样。

sentences.en: We love you so much, Sam.
sentences.zh: 我们太爱你了，萨姆。

sentences.en: I love you, too.
sentences.zh: 我也爱你们。

sentences.en: I can't believe the reach.
sentences.zh: 我真不敢相信这影响力。

sentences.zh: 五亿。

sentences.zh: 恭喜。

sentences.zh: 我确实为它感到骄傲。

sentences.zh: 我真的是。

sentences.zh: 女士！

sentences.zh: 然后我就应道：嘿，女士！

sentences.zh: 因为我立刻就知道他们是《办公室女士》的听众。

sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.zh: 我们《办公室女士》团队的最新成员。

sentences.zh: 我们需要让每个人都明白马特·比格尔有多棒。

sentences.en: Matt is just the most fantastic, calming presence.
sentences.zh: 马特简直是最棒、最令人安心的存在。

sentences.en: No matter what we need, when we need it, he's anticipated our need,
sentences.zh: 无论我们需要什么，什么时候需要，他都能预料到我们的需求，

sentences.en: and he's taking care of it.
sentences.zh: 并且他把一切都处理得妥妥当当。

sentences.zh: 马特，我希望你的家人知道你有多厉害。

sentences.en: You're a treasure, and you will do things that are just so near and dear to my heart,
sentences.zh: 你是个宝贝，你做的事情总是深深触动我的心，

sentences.zh: 但你里面有我们可能需要参考的所有其他谷歌文档的链接。

sentences.zh: 全都在一个文档里。

sentences.zh: 他知道我要和乔什去公路旅行。

sentences.zh: 我也能取消关注萨姆吗？

sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.zh: 他在这里有着如此丰富的故事。

sentences.zh: 我开玩笑呢。

sentences.zh: 这里真的是一个非常特别的地方。

sentences.en: I feel so lucky to be part of this team and family and history, and I'm just thrilled
sentences.zh: 能成为这个团队、这个大家庭和这段历史的一部分，我感到非常幸运，我也非常激动

sentences.zh: 能来到这里，并且为所有参与这一里程碑的人感到无比兴奋。

sentences.zh: 所以谢谢大家。

sentences.zh: 谢谢你，马特。

sentences.zh: 从第一天起。
